## Design

### 2026-11-08: I thought of a few things I could make, but I decided to make a chess timer. I like to play chess with my friend, and I thought that it would be fun to have a chess timer to use during a game. I start

**7h**

I thought of a few things I could make, but I decided to make a chess timer. I like to play chess with my friend, and I thought that it would be fun to have a chess timer to use during a game. I started the schematics, and thought that I should just use a Raspberry Pi Pico again since I was familier with it from the last project. I thought that I should use 5 buttons, one for white, one for black, and three for settings and adjustment.

![Screenshot 2026-11-07 140425](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/77ed35a6bf3ce2e8cb9db46656140199bcfa776256bf3dbeff7ad9de6a19a89c.png)

I also needed batteries since I didn't want to have it plugged in while playing chess. I put a slide switch for turning the timer on and off. I needed to add a power flag because it didn't recognize the 1x2 pins as a source of power.

![Screenshot 2026-11-07 140410](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/edcec9c136fc76551de15e1166ccb64e5ce4ca74f1d758a4c9d1aa5d669a6bdd.png)

Like the last project, I thought that it would be good to add a piezo buzzer for sound effects, like when time runs out or when the game begins.

![Screenshot 2026-11-07 140436](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/9c3e18624c4614de45c5dfc965608f1989d0e0c572b0580d5f3d41f7bfa61a5b.png)

After some quick changes, I finished the schematics for the project.

![Screenshot 2026-11-07 140456](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/f455247a94a7212e6bdde417f875e76285511a1ff5b852ead68ec755c92ae9c7.png)

I started adding the footprints after that and used a THT Pico, a THT resistor, a 1x2 pin header for the batteries, a 1x4 pin socket for the OLED, keyboard switches for the white/black switches, and tactile buttons for the other buttons.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/168e3686b0a3c8bb8392209255286ed9b0d8901855cd9bc65a897bcb2cf994eb.png)

I had wanted to use a lever-type switch like the real chess timers, but it would make the project more complicated, so I didn't.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/26c46050710d0377501f9ad0c50ff1c987696d8b76dc491f8c158f8d147b81be.png)

I started working on the PCB after that. I didn't want the whole timer to be on one plane, because usually the screen is perpendicular to the white/black switches, but it seemed like that would be the only way. I wanted a similar layout to last week's project, and I put the OLED on top of the Pico, with the buttons underneath it. Some of my connections to the Pico were messy, so I changed the schematics.

![Screenshot 2026-11-07 214501](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/c24622c12549d457fea835a708159ddbe71ee314f25656d0793095b1702480a8.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/7e0522a974292f729565eb20b28ad36ce8bf790939c29e508ff83cfd0d518441.png)

Then, the PCB became way nicer.

![Screenshot 2026-11-08 173553](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/cc98ec94f7b191f645a7d301fd0f0572854c39dfdc933422c848141e38e0c5c0.png)

### 2026-11-08: I fixed up my PCB one last bit, and changed the edge cuts a little so that my buttons could be further apart.

**5h**

I fixed up my PCB one last bit, and changed the edge cuts a little so that my buttons could be further apart.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/f503d9d89b56a16692dd61c189e4e305535a0a21ba9789b19a994991382d24b5.png)

I then proceded to making code and making the BOM. I wasn't too familier with the coding, and I used a little AI to understand it and help for my code. I made a simple interface where it lets you adjust the timer settings and then begins the game.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/2d05295e50a3faee3290e7e447e1854521a9b325dcd1d3a9935bf757768a1ba5.png)

I don't know if it will work, so I will have to wait until I can test it. I also had to order parts. Since I had a lot of tiny parts, I thought that DigiKey would be useful, along with AliExpress for the other parts.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/4e03d630ea3532c7339f94de267708406852ef8e97527c6334e443706896f9c8.png)

I also had some leftover parts from previous projects, so I didn't know whether I would have to ask for funding for the same thing in this project.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/da192dabd8154593a5d6a03d17b574125c42d1bbb92ca03da8c61c26f47fe18f.png)

I finally edited my code a little to add a pause option.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/ef623a5fae30078b8dd12dbda9c64354c8f747ac4719ceb1b1c782eca9ae8c9f.png)
